President Donald Trump hosted a delegation of prominent Hasidic rabbis and a Litvish rosh yeshiva at the White House on Thursday, September 3, for a pre-Rosh Hashanah meeting. The delegation included leaders associated with Satmar, Bobov, Skver and Vizhnitz, along with Rabbi Malkiel Kotler of Lakewood’s Beth Medrash Govoha. The Skverer Rebbe was represented by his son.  The meeting focused on issues affecting Orthodox Jewish communities, including religious liberty and the independence of yeshiva education. The Israeli military draft of Haredi yeshiva students was also expected to be a topic of discussion, although reports differed on how central that issue would be.  The gathering was notable because some of the invited leaders, particularly those associated with Satmar, hold strongly anti-Zionist or non-Zionist positions. That aspect of the invitation drew criticism from some pro-Israel voices.  The meeting also had historical significance: a similar gathering of leading rabbis at the White House took place under President Jimmy Carter in 1979, nearly 47 years earlier.  #AfriVisionMedia #Trump #WhiteHouse #RoshHashanah #Judaism
